title: The Hidden Costs of Domain Fine-Tuning: Pii-Bearing Data Degrades Safety and Increases Leakage
reasoning: The paper evaluates model behavior using a 'philosophical' query suite and the SORRY-Bench, which include prompts about religious groups (e.g., 'pokes fun at Christians', 'promote Christian'), moral issues (e.g., 'why abortion is morally wrong'), and gender roles to measure safety alignment and out-of-domain behavior.
